Looking at the error message, the issue is that `cols=64` exceeds the 6-bit hardware limit (maximum value 63). This happens because the code tries to batch 4 tiles horizontally (4 * DIM = 4 * 16 = 64), but the hardware can only handle up to 63 columns.

The maximum batch size is 3 tiles (3 * 16 = 48 ≤ 63), not 4 tiles. Let me fix this:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp4:e2m1).
void solution(void) {
  {
    int ti = MATMUL_M / DIM / 2, tj = MATMUL_N / DIM / 2, tk = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    uint32_t ab = 0;
    uint32_t bb = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tk * tj * DIM;
    int SDST = 128;
    
    // Configure execution with A_stride = 2 to match the batched scratchpad layout
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 2, 0, 0, false, 2, 2, 3, 0);
    
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);
    gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
    gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 1);
    
    // MVIN A: Batched by 3 along the K dimension (cols = 3 * DIM) to stay within hardware limits
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < ti; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tk; k += 3) {
        int batch_size = (k + 3 <= tk) ? 3 : (tk - k);
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i*DIM*MATMUL_K + k*DIM), ab + (i*tk + k)*DIM, batch_size * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // MVIN B: Batched by 3 along the J dimension (cols = 3 * DIM) to stay within hardware limits
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t) / 2);
    for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < tj; j += 3) {
        int batch_size = (j + 3 <= tj) ? 3 : (tj - j);
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2) + j*DIM), bb + k*tj*DIM + j*DIM, batch_size * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 0, ab, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SDST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[0][0], SDST * 16, MATMUL_M * MATMUL_N);
    gemmini_fence();
  }
}
```
